D: Agent J has to bring a neuralysed K back to stop an alien queen.
P: Serve dinner when Frank the pug sings in the car.
S: Mini pizza rounds, mozzarella, pepperoni. Two slices, says Serleena
Rounds of pizza dough topped with sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked at 230C for 8 minutes.
Pork and fennel rolls, by Kevin Brown, postmaster

Pork and fennel sausage rolls, sauce. Heat the oven to 200°C and line two trays. Mix the pork, onion, fennel seeds, breadcrumbs, 1 egg and a good pinch of salt and pepper. Cut each pastry sheet in half. Lay a log of filling along each half, roll up and press the seam down underneath. Cut each roll into 4, brush with the other egg, beaten, and bake for 25 minutes until golden and cooked through. Serve hot with tomato sauce.
M: Thin crust pizza with crushed tomato, mozzarella and crumbled Italian sausage
Cold-fermented dough stretched thin, crushed tomato, low-moisture mozzarella and crumbled sausage, on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes.
Ricotta and ham calzones. K hid a key here
Pizza dough folded over ricotta, mozzarella, ham and basil, crimped shut, baked at 230C for 15 minutes, marinara for dipping.
W: Cake doughnuts dipped in a sweet espresso glaze
Glazed coffee doughnuts with a sticky espresso icing. Mix 200g icing sugar with 3 tbsp strong espresso and 10g melted butter until smooth.
Chewy brown butter and brown sugar cookies, baked in small rounds
Brown butter cookie dough shaped into rounds, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, pug faces piped on with melted dark chocolate.
Chocolate pudding, biscuit dirt and gummy worms, for the worm guys
Chocolate pudding (milk, sugar, cocoa and cornflour whisked until thick) set in cups, topped with crushed biscuit and gummy worms.
K: Espresso, vanilla ice cream, milk and caramel, topped with cream and gummy worms

Espresso shake with gummy worms. Brew 4 espressos and cool for 10 minutes. Blend with 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 300ml cold milk and 2 tbsp caramel sauce until thick and smooth. Whip 300ml thickened cream to soft peaks. Pour the shakes into 4 tall glasses, top with the cream and drizzle with a little more caramel. Hang 2 gummy worms over each rim.

s.how: Roll out 500g pizza dough and cut into 16 rounds. Spread each with a spoon of pizza sauce, then add grated mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni. Bake on a hot tray at 230C for 8 minutes until the bases are crisp and the cheese bubbles.

s.note: Pork and fennel rolls, by Kevin Brown, postmaster

Lay a log of filling along each half, roll up and press the seam down underneath. Cut each roll into 4, brush with the other egg, beaten, and bake for 25 minutes until golden and cooked through. Serve hot with tomato sauce.

m.note: Thin crust pizza with crushed tomato, mozzarella and crumbled Italian sausage
m.how: Stretch 2 balls of cold-fermented dough, 500g in total, thin. Spread with 200g crushed tomato seasoned with salt. Top with 250g low-moisture mozzarella and 3 Italian sausages, skins off, crumbled. Bake on a steel at max heat for 7 minutes.
